    The multiplication table of the linearization of a ray category #

    The nonzero morphisms of a finite ray category P form a multiplicative basis of Linearization P k. The ray table of that basis (RayQuiver.linTable, in the sense of the multiplicative-bases library) has the nonzero morphisms as rays, the codomain as source and the domain as target, and its linearization is Linearization P k (RayQuiver.linTableEquiv).
